title: Appendix A — Proposal
text:
A Cold Case
Group Kick It: Abigail, Catriona, Lindsay
Short description of project: We plan to look to see how glacier size has changed from January 1, 1850 until today.
Research Questions:

How has the amount of glacier cover changed over time?
Are there certain regions that are more impacted than others?

Reason for Topic:

We chose this topic because we are interested in the environment and how certain aspects have been impacted by the use of fossil fuels have changed weather/temperature conditions, therefore changing the environment of the glaciers. We also want to see if there are any regions that have been less impacted and see what happens/doesn’t happen there to preserve the glacier cover in that area.

Data:

We plan to use the National Snow and Ice Center for our data. Depending on the ability to access it, we may need to pivot and choose another dataset. https://nsidc.org/data/nsidc-0272/versions/1

Communication Plan:

We will communicate via text and email. Expected response time: 3-5 Hours. We plan to check in with each other about the project for 15 minutes before/after class.

Roles:

Point of Contact: Abigail - Technical Lead: Lindsay - Style Lead: Catriona

Conflict Resolution:

If a team member misses a deadline we will check in with them via text to make sure they get caught up. Our team is made up of 3 people so we will go with majority rules in terms of decision making.
